1.explanation: The StyledRadioButtonBox styled component in StyledRadioButton.js unconditionally applies the theme.radioButton.check.background.color as its background-color, regardless of whether the radio button is checked. Meanwhile, the RadioButton component in RadioButton.js never passes a checked prop down into StyledRadioButtonBox, so the styled component has no way to know which buttons are selected. As a result, every radio button box always receives the 'checked' background color instead of only the checked one. To fix the bug, modify RadioButton to pass checked into StyledRadioButtonBox and update StyledRadioButtonBox’s styling to apply its background-color only when props.checked is true.
1.bug_scenario: In the provided screenshot and example, every radio button in the group is rendered with the blue background color (theme.radioButton.check.background.color), even when it is not selected. Only the currently checked radio button should show that colored background; all others should remain the default grey.

2.explanation: StyledRadioButtonBox (in StyledRadioButton.js) unconditionally applies the check.background.color from the theme to the box’s background, regardless of whether the radio is actually checked. Moreover, the RadioButton component never passes its checked prop down to StyledRadioButtonBox, so the styled component cannot conditionally render the background. To fix this, StyledRadioButtonBox must be updated to only apply the background-color when props.checked is true (and RadioButton must forward its checked prop to it). This will ensure only the selected radio button gets the custom background color.
2.bug_scenario: The custom theme defines radioButton.check.background.color as blue, but in the rendered UI every radio button (checked or not) shows the blue fill. Only the selected radio button should display the blue background; the others should remain the default grey. In the screenshot all three options appear filled blue.
